statement: Capture a view's settings into a template (scale, detail, VG, filters, range) and apply to many views.

source.doc: https://help.autodesk.com/view/RVT/2027/ENU/ ; Revit 2027 Help topic: View Template: Create and Apply

superiority: Show a live diff of what a template changes before applying.
notes: Acceptance sketch: Applying a template to 10 views sets all included parameters identically.

statement: Choose which view parameters a template controls and which remain free per view.

source.doc: https://help.autodesk.com/view/RVT/2027/ENU/ ; Revit 2027 Help topic: View Template: Included Parameters

superiority: Display the effective value source for every view setting.
notes: Acceptance sketch: Excluded parameter keeps its per-view value after apply.

statement: Assign a template to a view so settings follow the template and cannot drift.

source.doc: https://help.autodesk.com/view/RVT/2027/ENU/ ; Revit 2027 Help topic: View Template: Assigned to View

superiority: Warn when a view is manually changed against its template.
notes: Acceptance sketch: Changing the template updates assigned views.

statement: Control visibility, projection, cut lines, halftone, transparency and detail level per model category.

source.doc: https://help.autodesk.com/view/RVT/2027/ENU/ ; Revit 2027 Help topic: Visibility/Graphics: Model Categories

superiority: Search and sort categories with preview of override.
notes: Acceptance sketch: Hiding Walls hides every wall but not annotation.

statement: Control annotation visibility and overrides per annotation category.

source.doc: https://help.autodesk.com/view/RVT/2027/ENU/ ; Revit 2027 Help topic: Visibility/Graphics: Annotation Categories

superiority: Bulk set groups of annotation categories.
notes: Acceptance sketch: Hiding Dimensions removes dimensions from the view only.

statement: Control analytical model, imported CAD categories and revit link visibility.

source.doc: https://help.autodesk.com/view/RVT/2027/ENU/ ; Revit 2027 Help topic: Visibility/Graphics: Analytical and Imported

superiority: Layer-level named presets.
notes: Acceptance sketch: Hidden imported layer disappears.

statement: Apply view filters with overrides, visibility and halftone, ordered by priority.

source.doc: https://help.autodesk.com/view/RVT/2027/ENU/ ; Revit 2027 Help topic: Visibility/Graphics: Filters

superiority: Compose filters visually with a rule tree and match count.
notes: Acceptance sketch: Filter that colours walls red applies only to matching elements.

statement: Set link display (by host, by linked view, custom) with overrides.

source.doc: https://help.autodesk.com/view/RVT/2027/ENU/ ; Revit 2027 Help topic: Visibility/Graphics: Revit Links

superiority: Per-link overrides in view template.
notes: Acceptance sketch: Chosen linked view shows.

statement: Control display by workset and design option per view.

source.doc: https://help.autodesk.com/view/RVT/2027/ENU/ ; Revit 2027 Help topic: Visibility/Graphics: Worksets and Design Options

superiority: Preview design option compare side by side.
notes: Acceptance sketch: Workset hidden is not drawn.

statement: Define a filter on categories with rules on parameters (equals, contains, greater than, has value).

source.doc: https://help.autodesk.com/view/RVT/2027/ENU/ ; Revit 2027 Help topic: Filters: Rule-Based Filter

superiority: Support nested AND/OR groups and live match list.
notes: Acceptance sketch: Filter selects exactly elements meeting the rule in a seeded model.

statement: Define a filter from a set of selected elements for fixed membership.

source.doc: https://help.autodesk.com/view/RVT/2027/ENU/ ; Revit 2027 Help topic: Filters: Selection Filter

superiority: Convert a selection filter to rules.
notes: Acceptance sketch: Filter holds the selected set.

statement: Filters may span categories only when they share the filtered parameters.

source.doc: https://help.autodesk.com/view/RVT/2027/ENU/ ; Revit 2027 Help topic: Filters: Parameter Rules Cross Categories

superiority: Resolve parameter mismatches with hints.
notes: Acceptance sketch: Cross-category filter works with shared parameters.

statement: Define phases such as existing, demolition and new construction with sequential ordering.

source.doc: https://help.autodesk.com/view/RVT/2027/ENU/ ; Revit 2027 Help topic: Phases: Phase Creation

superiority: Merge and rename phases while preserving elements.
notes: Acceptance sketch: Phase list is ordered and used by elements.

statement: Assign each element a phase created and phase demolished to control display by phase.

source.doc: https://help.autodesk.com/view/RVT/2027/ENU/ ; Revit 2027 Help topic: Phases: Created and Demolished

superiority: Bulk phasing by selection with date mapping.
notes: Acceptance sketch: Demolished element hidden in later phase view.

statement: Define phase filters showing new, existing, demolished and temporary elements with overrides.

source.doc: https://help.autodesk.com/view/RVT/2027/ENU/ ; Revit 2027 Help topic: Phases: Phase Filters

superiority: Compose phase filters with a visual matrix.
notes: Acceptance sketch: New walls show with the new override in the phase view.

statement: Mark elements as demolished in the current phase.

source.doc: https://help.autodesk.com/view/RVT/2027/ENU/ ; Revit 2027 Help topic: Phases: Demolish Tool

superiority: Whole-assembly demolition by room pick.
notes: Acceptance sketch: Demolished element shows dashed in the phase view.

statement: Create option sets with a primary and alternative options for design alternatives.

source.doc: https://help.autodesk.com/view/RVT/2027/ENU/ ; Revit 2027 Help topic: Design Options: Option Sets

superiority: Compare options side by side in one view.
notes: Acceptance sketch: Primary option shows by default in all views.

statement: Enter an option to edit elements that belong to it.

source.doc: https://help.autodesk.com/view/RVT/2027/ENU/ ; Revit 2027 Help topic: Design Options: Edit Option

superiority: Visual indicator of the current option.
notes: Acceptance sketch: Edits in an option do not change the main model.

statement: Choose which option of each set shows in each view.

source.doc: https://help.autodesk.com/view/RVT/2027/ENU/ ; Revit 2027 Help topic: Design Options: Per-View Visibility

superiority: Preview options in tooltips.
notes: Acceptance sketch: Different options show in two views simultaneously.

statement: Accept the primary option to finalise it into the main model and discard the others.

source.doc: https://help.autodesk.com/view/RVT/2027/ENU/ ; Revit 2027 Help topic: Design Options: Accept Primary

superiority: Keep archived options as snapshot.
notes: Acceptance sketch: After accept the main model includes the primary only.

statement: Define top, cut plane, bottom and view depth for plan views with offsets.

source.doc: https://help.autodesk.com/view/RVT/2027/ENU/ ; Revit 2027 Help topic: View Range

superiority: Show the view range as a live section overlay.
notes: Acceptance sketch: Elements above cut plane are drawn with the projected style.

statement: Show another level's geometry as an underlay in plan with orientation.

source.doc: https://help.autodesk.com/view/RVT/2027/ENU/ ; Revit 2027 Help topic: Underlay

superiority: Multi-level underlays.
notes: Acceptance sketch: Underlay elements are halftone.

statement: Set coarse, medium or fine detail and visual style (wireframe, hidden, shaded, consistent colours, realistic).

source.doc: https://help.autodesk.com/view/RVT/2027/ENU/ ; Revit 2027 Help topic: Detail Level and Visual Style

superiority: Consistent GPU shading across styles.
notes: Acceptance sketch: Detail Level Fine shows layered wall structure.

statement: Control model display style, shadows, sketchy lines, depth cueing, lighting, background and silhouette per view.

source.doc: https://help.autodesk.com/view/RVT/2027/ENU/ ; Revit 2027 Help topic: Graphic Display Options

superiority: Provide named, shareable graphics presets that apply to many views in one step.
notes: Acceptance sketch: Enabling shadows changes shading of a sphere above a plane in the expected direction.

statement: Set a view discipline to coordinate, architectural, structural, mechanical or electrical display.

source.doc: https://help.autodesk.com/view/RVT/2027/ENU/ ; Revit 2027 Help topic: Discipline Setting

superiority: Fine discipline combos.
notes: Acceptance sketch: Mechanical discipline greys architectural elements.

statement: Control far clip offset and depth for sections and elevations so deep geometry is trimmed.

source.doc: https://help.autodesk.com/view/RVT/2027/ENU/ ; Revit 2027 Help topic: Far Clip and Depth

superiority: Show the clip plane as a draggable overlay in plan.
notes: Acceptance sketch: Elements beyond the far clip are not drawn in the section.

statement: Override halftone and surface transparency for categories or elements in a view.

source.doc: https://help.autodesk.com/view/RVT/2027/ENU/ ; Revit 2027 Help topic: Halftone and Transparency Overrides

superiority: Live preview of an override while moving the slider.
notes: Acceptance sketch: Transparency of 50 percent renders surfaces see-through to that degree.

statement: Override line, pattern, colour and transparency for the selected elements in the current view only.

source.ref: Override Graphics in View by Element
source.doc: https://help.autodesk.com/view/RVT/2027/ENU/ ; Revit 2027 Help topic: Override Graphics in View by Element

superiority: Keep a history of overrides with named restore points.
notes: Acceptance sketch: Override appears only in the active view and is cleared by reset.

statement: Split a face to apply a different material to a region and paint materials on faces.

source.doc: https://help.autodesk.com/view/RVT/2027/ENU/ ; Revit 2027 Help topic: Split Face and Paint

superiority: Paint with live material preview.
notes: Acceptance sketch: Painted region area equals the split.

statement: Override cut edges and linework by edge in a view with edit profile and linework tools.

source.doc: https://help.autodesk.com/view/RVT/2027/ENU/ ; Revit 2027 Help topic: Cut Profile and Linework Overrides

superiority: Persist linework edits through geometry changes within tolerance.
notes: Acceptance sketch: Edited edge prints with the new style in the view only.

statement: Assign default view templates to new views by view type so new views start in standards.

source.doc: https://help.autodesk.com/view/RVT/2027/ENU/ ; Revit 2027 Help topic: Default View Template by Type

superiority: Ship office template packs that can be versioned.
notes: Acceptance sketch: A new floor plan inherits the default template.

statement: Copy selected view properties from one view onto other views.

source.doc: https://help.autodesk.com/view/RVT/2027/ENU/ ; Revit 2027 Help topic: Match View Properties

superiority: Select attributes with a diff preview.
notes: Acceptance sketch: Chosen properties equal the source after match.

statement: Set graphic overrides for new, existing, demolished and temporary phase statuses.

source.doc: https://help.autodesk.com/view/RVT/2027/ENU/ ; Revit 2027 Help topic: Phases: Overrides per Status

superiority: Preview the effect on a sample before applying.
notes: Acceptance sketch: Each status renders with its override colour.
